DEFINE INSTRUMENT d2b_diffractometer (
lambda = 1.0, // Angs
DM = 0.0, // Angs
string Powder = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz", 
RV = -1.0, // m
L1 = 16.05, // m
L2 = 2.645, // m
L3 = 1.3, // m
int verbose = 1.0, 
ALPHA1 = 18.0, // min
ALPHA2 = 11.0, // min
ALPHA3 = 5.0, // min
ETA = 12.0, // min
THETA_M = 67.5, // deg
TILT = 0.0, // deg
SM = 1.0, 
Dheight = 0.3, // m
coating = 0.0 
)

DECLARE 
%{
double L = 0.0;
double KI = 0.0;
double Vi = 0.0;
double EI = 0.0;
double ALPHA3_Opt = 0.0;
double U = 0.0;
double V = 0.0;
double W = 0.0;
double L0 = 0.0;
string lamopts = lambda limits=[0, 0];
%}

INITIALIZE 
%{
// Start of initialize for generated d2b_diffractometer
%}

TRACE 
COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
 radius = 0.11, dist = 11,
 focus_xw = fabs(0.05*fabs(sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M))), focus_yh = 0.3,
 focus_aw = 0, focus_ah = 0,
 lambda0 = lambda, dlambda = lambda*0.01,
 I1 = 5874000000000, T1 = 683.7,
 T2 = 257.7, I2 = 25099000000000,
 T3 = 16.7, I3 = 1034300000000)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win0 = Slit(
 radius = 0.11)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.462) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Oct1 = Slit(
 xwidth = 0.15, yheight = 0.15)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.512) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Oct2 = Slit(
 xwidth = 0.177, yheight = 0.177)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.512) RELATIVE Origin
ROTATED (0.0, 0.0, 45.0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win1 = Slit(
 radius = 0.0565)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 3.5321) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win2 = Slit(
 radius = 0.0555)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.0421) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win3 = Slit(
 radius = 0.0575)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.087) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win4 = Slit(
 radius = 0.0575)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.999) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win5 = Slit(
 radius = 0.0625)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 5.006) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win6 = Slit(
 radius = 0.0625)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 5.151) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT SMguide = Guide(
 w1 = 0.07, h1 = 0.3,
 l = 5, m = coating)
WHEN ((coating>0))
AT (0.0, 0.0, 11.0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Alpha_One = Collimator_linear(
 xwidth = 0.07, yheight = 0.3,
 length = 0.7, divergence = ALPHA1,
 transmission = 1)
WHEN ((ALPHA1>0))
AT (0.0, 0.0, L1-1.045) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Slit_Mono = Slit(
 xwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.3)
AT (0.0, 0.0, L1-0.1) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT D2B_Mono_XY = Monitor_nD(
 xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.3,
 bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1,
 options = "x y")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Slit_Mono

COMPONENT D2B_ALPHA1_Div = Monitor_nD(
 xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.3,
 bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1,
 options = "dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE D2B_Mono_XY

COMPONENT D2B_Mono_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
 xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.3,
 bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1,
 options = "lambda limits=[0.99, 1.01]")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE D2B_ALPHA1_Div

COMPONENT mono_cradle = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, L1) RELATIVE Origin

SPLIT 10 COMPONENT Monok = Monochromator_curved(
 NH = 1, NV = 28,
 mosaich = ETA, mosaicv = 12,
 RV = RV, DM = DM,
 width = 0.1, height = 0.3)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
ROTATED (0.0, THETA_M+TILT, 0.0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT sphere = PSD_monitor_4PI(
 filename = "sphere", radius = 0.5,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT mono_out = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
ROTATED (0.0, 2*THETA_M, 0.0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT Shield_Hole = Guide_channeled(
 w1 = 0.05, h1 = 0.274,
 w2 = 0.044, h2 = 0.201,
 l = 0.752, R0 = 0,
 nslit = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.304) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT Alpha_Two = Collimator_linear(
 xwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.2,
 length = 0.2, divergence = ALPHA2,
 transmission = 1)
WHEN ((ALPHA2>0))
AT (0.0, 0.0, L2-0.25) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT Slit_Sample = Slit(
 xwidth = 0.01, yheight = 0.05)
AT (0.0, 0.0, L2-0.02) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT D2B_ALPHA2_Div = Monitor_nD(
 xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.05,
 bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1,
 options = "dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Slit_Sample

COMPONENT D2B_Sample_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
 xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.05,
 bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1,
 options = "lambda limits=[0.99, 1.01]")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE D2B_ALPHA2_Div

SPLIT 10 COMPONENT Arm_Sample = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, L2) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT Container_in = PowderN(
 reflections = "V.lau", radius = 0.00301,
 yheight = 0.04, thickness = 0.0005,
 d_phi = 15, p_interact = 0.1,
 concentric = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Arm_Sample

COMPONENT Sample = PowderN(
 reflections = Powder, radius = 0.0025,
 yheight = 0.04, d_phi = 15)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Arm_Sample

COMPONENT Container_out = PowderN(
 reflections = "V.lau", radius = 0.00301,
 yheight = 0.04, thickness = 0.0005,
 d_phi = 15, p_interact = 0.1,
 concentric = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Arm_Sample

COMPONENT collimador_radial = Collimator_radial(
 yheight = 0.3, length = 0.3,
 divergence = ALPHA3, theta_min = -165,
 theta_max = -5, radius = 0.99,
 verbose = 1, approx = 1)
WHEN ((ALPHA3>0))
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Sample

COMPONENT D2B_BananaTheta = Monitor_nD(
 yheight = 0.3, bins = 3200,
 restore_neutron = 1, radius = 0.99,
 options = "banana, angle limits=[5 165]")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Sample

COMPONENT D2B_BananaThetaCenter = Monitor_nD(
 yheight = 0.1, bins = 3200,
 restore_neutron = 1, radius = 0.99,
 options = "banana, angle limits=[5 165]")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Sample

COMPONENT D2B_BananaPSD = Monitor_nD(
 yheight = 0.3, bins = 320,
 radius = 0.995, options = "banana, theta limits=[-165 -5] bins=320, y bins=25")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Sample

FINALLY 
%{
// Start of finally for generated d2b_diffractometer
%}
